{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
severe_valid = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value in ng/mL
mean_baseline_severe = severe_valid['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Number of SEVERE patients after removing -999: {len(severe_valid)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline_severe}")"}
